name: Ca mu
summary: Cá mú is a fish from Đầm Lập An. A 1 October 2016 feature says guests eat it from fish raised under a raft. Nhân Dân names cá mú lưới as a fish in the lagoon and does not give a recipe.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Viện Kinh tế xã hội Hà Nội, 1 October 2016. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, names cá mú lưới in the lagoon.
howToEat: The 2016 feature does not name a cooking method or a shop. Nhân Dân does not say cá mú lưới is the same fish.
A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Lập An. No door is named.
